estimate_doubly_robust: run DoublyRobustEstimator.estimate to compute direct method, IPS, and doubly robust CPE estimates from an EvaluationDataPage
split_data_train_valid_eval: use DoublyRobustEstimator._split_data to partition an EvaluationDataPage into training, validation, and evaluation subsets
get_importance_sampling_inputs: call DoublyRobustEstimator._get_importance_sampling_inputs to compute importance weights from target and logged propensities
create_doubly_robust_hp: create a DoublyRobustHP NamedTuple to configure bootstrap samples, train/valid fractions, and XGBoost parameters
prepare_estimation_data: use DoublyRobustEstimator._prepare_data to convert an EvaluationDataPage into an EstimationData dataclass for evaluation
